ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity (black) pixels, comprising approximately 85-90% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in markings accounting for 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous low-intensity dark field. High-contrast white geometric clusters are concentrated at the distal fluke tips, with discrete, circular/elliptical white spots and thin linear disruptions scattered across the medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with acute angular convergence at the peduncle attachment point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel amplitude and jaggedness on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the posterior boundary, sweeping upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters; one prominent 'eye' or 'bullseye' mark in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe, and dense white clusters at the extreme lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) concentrated on the distal third of both lobes, appearing as parallel and crisscrossing unaligned pixel disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of sessile barnacles visible on the far lateral tips of both lobes; extensive white linear scarring (likely rake marks) across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly specific concentric ring/circle marking on the medial right lobe and dense 'web-like' white pigmentation patterns on the fluke tips.
